A.rationale: The page leads from a descriptive headline through a single Specifications toolbar into a clear matrix. The throughput row is immediately locatable.
strengths: Section title, count and actions form one group at 1440 and 834.
The tinted Runs per hour row adds a strong entry point for this lab's use case.

Price and warranty are visually ordinary in the starting table despite the brief's tradeoff focus.
A.opportunity: Compress the narrow-screen introduction and bring price and warranty into the same emphasis system as throughput.

B.rationale: The serif heading and right-aligned cells are readable, with an unusually heavy sans weight on secondary hierarchy levels.

The mobile heading is much more prominent than the content controls.

C.rationale: Warm white, sage and forest tones create a calm, legible enclosure with deliberate row separators.

The distinct edge at the mobile specification column helps anchor rows.
defects: Wide desktop rows put long horizontal gaps between labels and values.
Reset and the scroll hint occupy separate strips on mobile.
C.opportunity: Share one mobile strip between Reset and the scrolling cue if it can keep both targets clear.

D.rationale: The warm scientific identity is cohesive and quiet, with most expression concentrated in type and the brand mark.

defects: Display-heavy model names feel more expressive than the tabular content needs.

E.rationale: Both toggles are explicitly labeled with discernible on/off state, and the supplied actions produce the requested narrowed table and mobile reset.

F.rationale: The rendered comparison grid, counts and control treatments stay coherent through the captured states. The browser reports no document overflow.
strengths: Rows and column alignment survive filtering and reset.

visual_problems: Heavy model headings compete with the actual values.

B.rationale: The straightforward sans hierarchy suits a utility, with orderly right-aligned figures and comfortable row text.
strengths: Model names and values align cleanly on tablet and desktop.

defects: Mobile Operating noise needs two lines.

C.rationale: Cool blue-green surfaces and subtle banding are organized, though the tablet hero graphics run behind the heading and paragraph.

defects: At 834, orbital lines extend under the title and supporting copy.
The mobile scroll instruction and tall model-art band add two layers above the values.

D.rationale: The cool instrument-panel palette and repeated device silhouettes give the comparison a technical identity.

Responsive behavior removes the orbital pattern at phone width.
defects: The orbital motif and near-identical device drawings take space with little comparative information.
The product strip feels closer to a catalog than an at-a-glance lab utility.

E.rationale: The toggles, reset and scoped mobile comparison are discoverable, and the browser scenarios show the expected filtered and restored values.
strengths: The mobile scroll prompt is distinct and explicit.

defects: The tablet controls shift vertically when filtering, making repeat adjustments less predictable.
Mobile comparison takes a substantial vertical scroll before reaching warranty and noise.

F.rationale: The repeated row, switch and product-header treatments hold together in both captured states, with scoped document geometry at 390.
strengths: Verified filtered text and full reset retain data and units.

visual_problems: Tablet hero lines cross readable copy.
Tall hero and model artwork delay mobile data.
Changing the count makes tablet actions jump to a second row.
effective_decisions: Direct Hide Alder A2 label matches the requested action.
Row banding and numeric alignment make wide comparisons tractable.
The mobile prompt explicitly describes scoped horizontal scrolling.

A.rationale: The succinct title and compressed toolbar put the comparison early in the viewport. Weight ranks price, throughput and warranty without disrupting table order.
strengths: All eight row labels are visible in the initial 390×844 screenshot.
Key numeric tradeoffs form a prominent, vertically scannable pattern.
The 834 filtered toolbar stays in place.

Reset sits on a separate mobile line, albeit alongside the scroll cue.

B.rationale: The expressive serif title and restrained sans UI balance brand and operation; numeric weight is applied selectively.
strengths: Model headings and tabular values follow aligned right edges.
Full Operating noise and model labels remain readable on one line at 390.
defects: The narrow scroll instruction is small and visually lighter than neighboring actions.
Small desktop instrument glyphs sit close to the heavy model headers.

C.rationale: Warm cream, a forest brand bar and faint sage banding give enough structure while preserving quiet space around the matrix.

The alternating fills and subtle vertical rules carry the reader through all models.

D.rationale: A concise field-specific title, monochrome brand bar and compact product cues produce a credible lab tool.

The mobile variant drops device icons while retaining model identity.
defects: The nearly identical icons contribute little model distinction at larger widths.
The serif heading is more expressive than the compact controls.

E.rationale: The two explicit toggles, scoped overflow cue and persistent reset support the specified workflow at all widths.

visual_problems: Mobile Cedar relies on a small scroll cue.

effective_decisions: All eight rows fit within the captured phone viewport.
Price, throughput and warranty receive selective emphasis.
Filtered tablet controls remain in their original positions.

pairs.rationale: The green matrix starts substantially higher on mobile, calls out throughput, and retains the tablet toolbar position in the narrowed state. The teal version has readable figures but its tablet artwork crosses copy and its model illustrations delay the first row.
The compact cream layout exposes every specification within the initial phone height and emphasizes all three core numeric tradeoffs. Its tablet toolbar also keeps its placement after filtering.

Both palettes balance identity and clarity. The shorter title and toolbar in ui-bb7de2 show the full comparison height on mobile, and the selective weight on price and warranty improves the desktop scan. ui-fae666 has the clearer reset button and strongest throughput marker.

D.rationale: The compact blueprint rail, navy shell, lime accents and site-specific confirmation create a distinct but credible operations identity.

The strong brand treatment survives the mobile reflow.
defects: The separate header's Facilities services tag is generic, especially on phone.
D.opportunity: Let the progress and form lead on phones by giving the redundant header tag less prominence.

E.rationale: Explicit Required labels, an obvious current step, visible input guidance and a focused field-specific error support the narrow-screen recovery path.

defects: The captures stop at final success, leaving the visual layout of Inspection and Review unverified.

visual_problems: Heavy heading lettering competes on the wide split panel.

The compact navy panel, explicit Required markers and completed, site-specific confirmation give ui-e1df93 a slight edge. The green version has calmer typography, a full-width mobile button and a more actionable email error.

The green design has a clearer typographic hierarchy, linked progress, stronger form-action alignment and a field error example. The blue design shows a strong active step and preserves progress in the completion view.
